title: vps show JSON
description: Payload of `ssh-cli vps show <VPS> --json`, with every secret masked to a fixed marker. Seven fields are conditional and vanish when unset rather than appearing empty: tags, tls, tls_sni, tls_client_cert, tls_client_key, use_agent, agent_socket. Carries no `event` discriminator. Each run emits one of two shapes: the full record when no shaping flag was passed, or a reduced record that adds `agent_shape` when `--select`, `--truncate-content` or a collection-only flag was passed. `--select` also drops every field outside the selection; `--truncate-content` and the collection-only flags keep the record whole, so both variants are matched with `anyOf` rather than `oneOf`. `vps list --json` emits an array of the full records, so `vps-list.schema.json` inherits every field here, `use_agent` and `agent_socket` included.

tags.description: Host tags used by the `--tags` fleet selector on the exec family. Omitted when empty (`skip_serializing_if`), never emitted as `[]`.

tls.description: True when this host runs SSH inside a rustls TLS tunnel. Omitted when false, so absence means plain TCP.

tls_sni.description: SNI presented on the TLS handshake. Omitted when unset.

tls_client_cert.description: Absolute path to the mTLS client certificate, when the host authenticates with one. Omitted when unset.

tls_client_key.description: Absolute path to the mTLS client key. Omitted when unset; never contains key material.

use_agent.description: True when this host authenticates through the SSH agent. Omitted when false, so absence means password or key auth.

agent_socket.description: Explicit agent socket or Windows named pipe. Omitted when unset, meaning the platform default endpoint is used.

agent_shape.description: Present only on a reduced run. `selected` lists the dotted paths that were projected, `content_truncated` is true when `--truncate-content` shortened a string, and `ignored` names the collection-only flags that cannot apply to a single record, so a reduction is never silent.

password.description: Empty/key-only hosts serialize as null; non-empty is the masked string "***"
